verdict.rationale: Weave's marketing site says built-in and custom signals automatically classify agent interactions, and that alerts can send Slack notifications and trigger webhook automations. That is a native, background, event-driven automation capability, but it is described only in marketing copy, not in setup docs. The 'automatic iteration loops' claim depends on external coding agents connecting through the MCP server, so it is not credited as the product's own automation. Missing for 10: first-party docs on configuring automations or alert triggers, scheduled or recurring jobs (e.g., recurring evaluations), details on what automation actions are available, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Alerts route what matters through Slack notifications and trigger webhook automations, turning every production insight into a fast iteration.
Built-in and custom signals automatically capture and classify agent interactions, so you always know how your agents are behaving.
